sql: SELECT "Claims"."Claim_ID" AS k, (CAST("Claims"."Amount_Settled" AS REAL) / "Claims"."Amount_Claimed") AS m1 FROM "Claims" WHERE (CAST("Claims"."Amount_Settled" AS REAL) / "Claims"."Amount_Claimed") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claims.amount settled relative to amount claimed
why: amount settled / amount claimed: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank Claims rows by amount settled relative to amount claimed

sql: SELECT "Settlements"."Settlement_ID" AS k, ("Settlements"."Amount_Claimed" - "Settlements"."Amount_Settled") AS m1 FROM "Settlements" WHERE ("Settlements"."Amount_Claimed" - "Settlements"."Amount_Settled") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: amount claimed - amount settled: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one settlement of a claim
rank Settlements rows by amount claimed minus amount settled
